answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that unlocks only after a record of verified useful work, so an operator cannot flood the market with a river of free fake identities. Like a raven that must prove it can find food before the flock follows it, each identity earns trust slowly; a sonnet of cheap self-praise buys nothing without stake and work behind it. A Sybil attacker must fund and work every fake identity, while an honest agent pays once.
